clue.text: Outstanding account which proved to be unworthy of credit

definitions.text: Outstanding account which proved to be unworthy of credit

parts.words: Outstanding account which proved to be unworthy of credit
parts.note: an unpaid bill whose debtor turned out not to deserve the credit given, so it will never be settled

explanation.surface: An unpaid bill reveals that a customer could not be trusted with credit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Outstanding' means unpaid, and 'unworthy of credit' plays on the debtor not being creditworthy.
explanation.definitionFit: A loan or invoice that will never be repaid is written off as uncollectable, an outstanding sum given to someone undeserving of trust.

clue.text: Spirit traditionally associated with wine

parts.note: the Roman deity, a divine being, of the grape harvest and revelry

explanation.surface: A liquor has long been linked with wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spirit' suggests liquor, but it is a god.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman god of grapes and revelry, Dionysus to the Greeks.

clue.text: One who takes steps to measure with another

definitions.text: One who takes steps to measure with another

parts.words: One who takes steps to measure with another
parts.note: a 'measure' is a dance, so this person steps in time together with someone

explanation.surface: Someone takes action to assess things alongside a colleague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes steps' and 'measure' both have dance senses.
explanation.definitionFit: The person one dances with, keeping time to music together.

clue.text: Give out when time is up

indicators.note: in a down clue, going up means the word is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Something is issued when the clock runs out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is up' turns TIME backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To send forth light, heat or sound is to discharge it.

clue.text: They occur in a seismic-belt remorselessly

definitions.text: They occur in a seismic-belt remorselessly

indicators.note: found within, so the letters lie inside the following words

explanation.surface: Quakes strike relentlessly in an earthquake zone.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer runs through 'belT REMORSelessly', and the whole clue also defines it.
explanation.definitionFit: Shakings of the earth naturally happen in seismic zones.

clue.text: Many better men have a stake in them

definitions.meaning: a great number

definitions.text: better men have a stake in them
definitions.meaning: people who bet put money on draws or auction items, the units that are drawn or sold

explanation.surface: Gamblers have money riding on all sorts of things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'better' here is one who bets, not 'superior'.
explanation.definitionFit: Plenty in quantity; also the drawn tickets or sale items on which bettors wager money.

clue.text: Janitor's cupboards

parts.note: a janitor secures doors, and the storage units that fasten with a key

explanation.surface: Storage in the caretaker's room.
explanation.walkthrough: A janitor is one who locks up; the storage cabinets are named for that action.
explanation.definitionFit: Small lockable cabinets, as found in schools and gyms.

clue.text: Thank you, and again, goodbye

indicators.note: repeated once more, so the word is given twice

parts.note: TA is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: A polite word of thanks, then a farewell.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is everyday British slang for thanks; doubled it is an informal farewell.
explanation.definitionFit: A casual British farewell, like bye-bye.

clue.text: Remove house-bound wife's cause for complaint

definitions.meaning: extract or take away
a wife stuck at home grumbles that she is never taken on outings

explanation.surface: A stay-at-home spouse has something to grumble about.
explanation.definitionFit: To extract; also what a neglected spouse wants: an evening out.

clue.text: O, read it all you to whom it is addressed!

definitions.text: O, read it all you to whom it is addressed!

parts.words: O, read it all you to whom it is addressed!
parts.note: O looks round, and a mailing sent to many addressees invites all of them to read

explanation.surface: A dramatic appeal for everyone addressed to read the message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'O' hints at round shape; the item is mailed to a whole list.
explanation.definitionFit: A single message copied and sent to many recipients.

clue.text: Assurance shown with a round of cards? It's a swindle!.

parts.note: self-assurance means confidence
in card games one round of play, where each player lays a card, is a trick

explanation.surface: A card sharp plays with poise, and the whole game is a con.
explanation.definitionFit: A fraud in which the victim's trust is won and then betrayed is a classic con.

clue.text: Said to be the air of one who succeeds

indicators.note: something said is spoken, so the word that follows is heard rather than read

parts.note: the word air, taken as it stands, is the sound being matched

explanation.surface: A successor is said to carry a certain manner about them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'air' looks like a manner or bearing; it is only the sound wanted.
explanation.definitionFit: The person who inherits a title or estate is the one who follows on, or succeeds, the holder.

clue.text: Managed to be dressed as a priest

definitions.meaning: got by, handled a situation

definitions.text: to be dressed as a priest
definitions.meaning: a cope is a long ecclesiastical cloak, so someone wearing one is so dressed

explanation.surface: Someone got by in a clerical disguise.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting through a difficulty is coping; wearing the semicircular vestment called a cope is also this.

clue.text: Stop for an organist spurned by Narcissus

definitions.meaning: an organ stop producing a soft repeat of a passage
the nymph in Greek myth whose love the self-admiring youth rejected

explanation.surface: An organ player halts, rejected by a vain beauty.
explanation.definitionFit: A repeating organ register bears the name of the mythical nymph who pined away after rejection by Narcissus.

clue.text: Grab erected over point on a mercantile river

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first piece sits above the second
set upright, so in a down clue the word is read upwards

parts.note: E is east, a compass point

explanation.surface: A crane on a trading river lifts something above a quay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'erected' turns GRAB to BARG, placed over E. The definition is loose: the craft is found on commercial waterways.
explanation.definitionFit: A flat-bottomed cargo boat working trade routes along waterways.

clue.text: The only amusing part of slaughter

definitions.text: The only amusing part of slaughter

indicators.note: a section within, so the letters come from inside the next word

explanation.surface: A grim joke that the killing has just one funny side.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is inside 'sLAUGHter', and the whole clue describes it.
explanation.definitionFit: Chuckling is the only humorous element tucked within a massacre.

clue.text: Slang is returning for long distance communications

indicators.note: going back, so the letters of the two words are read in the other direction

explanation.surface: Street talk is making a comeback in telecommunications.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns SLANGIS round.
explanation.definitionFit: Messages sent across distance by flags, radio or lamps are transmissions of this kind.

clue.text: Shot everyone in the heart it's enough to make a hungry man cry!

definitions.text: it's enough to make a hungry man cry

indicators.note: placed into the middle of the word that comes before it in the clue

parts.note: everyone means all

explanation.surface: A gunman fires at everyone's hearts, a scene to reduce anyone to tears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in the heart' puts ALL inside SHOT. The definition is whimsical: a cook peeling this bulb weeps.
explanation.definitionFit: A small onion, whose fumes bring tears to the eyes of a cook preparing food.

clue.text: Horse used by motorist when his battery is flat

definitions.meaning: a cavalry or war horse

definitions.text: used by motorist when his battery is flat
definitions.meaning: a device that replenishes a car battery

explanation.surface: A driver with a dead battery reaches for a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A knight's mount in battle; also the electrical device that restores power to a flat car battery.

clue.text: It strikes Tom as being an appreciate listener

definitions.meaning: the tongue of a bell hits it; Great Tom is a famous bell in Oxford
an audience member who applauds

explanation.surface: Tom finds himself an enthusiastic member of the audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tom' looks like a man but is a bell, such as Great Tom of Christ Church, Oxford.
explanation.definitionFit: The hanging tongue of a bell; also someone who applauds a performance.

clue.text: Use ride as substitute for rest

indicators.note: the letters are swapped around in place of their original order

explanation.surface: Ride instead of walking to get a break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as substitute' signals rearranging USERIDE.
explanation.definitionFit: What is left over, the remainder.

clue.text: Numbers watched by dieters

definitions.meaning: digits or numerals
people slimming keep an eye on their body shapes

explanation.surface: Slimmers keep track of the numbers.
explanation.definitionFit: Numerals; also bodily shapes that slimmers monitor.

clue.text: Burden priest with a team of rowing men

parts.note: FR is short for Father, a priest's title
a racing crew of eight oarsmen is called an eight

explanation.surface: A cleric is weighed down by a boat crew.
explanation.definitionFit: Cargo or a load to be carried.

clue.text: South America wearies of politically staged acts

parts.note: wearies means tires

explanation.surface: South America grows weary of political theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: Lampoons and mocking plays aimed at public figures and politics.

clue.text: Apostolic Book of laws?

definitions.meaning: the fifth book of the New Testament, recording the Apostles' deeds
statutes passed by Parliament

explanation.surface: A scriptural book is queried as a legal code.
explanation.definitionFit: The New Testament book of the Apostles; also statutes enacted by a legislature.

clue.text: Paling made of wood

definitions.meaning: turning pale, losing colour
made from the timber of the ash tree

explanation.surface: A fence is built of timber.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paling' looks like a fence post but means going white.
explanation.definitionFit: Grey-faced with shock; also built from ash timber.

clue.text: Many consume high protein food

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, so stands for many
to consume food is to eat

explanation.surface: Many people consume protein-rich food.
explanation.definitionFit: Animal flesh is a staple source of protein.

clue.text: Seal up pots

indicators.note: in a down clue, the word is read from the bottom upwards

explanation.surface: Someone seals jars shut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns POTS backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To block or plug an opening.

clue.text: Pack away for a point to point

parts.note: S is south, a compass point
W is west, another compass point

explanation.surface: Packing up for a cross-country horse race.
explanation.walkthrough: A point-to-point is a British amateur steeplechase race; here it is read as compass point, TO, compass point.
explanation.definitionFit: To store something neatly out of the way.

clue.text: His act calls for a handy turn of speed

definitions.text: His act calls for a handy turn of speed

parts.words: His act calls for a handy turn of speed
parts.note: a stage performer whose trick depends on quick, deft hands

explanation.surface: A performer's routine depends on quickness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'handy' means done by hand: sleight of hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A conjuror relies on nimble fingers to deceive the audience.

clue.text: All that remains of church when college escapes from collapse?

indicators.note: getting out of something, so these letters leave the word that follows

parts.note: COLL is an abbreviation for college

explanation.surface: Only a fragment of a church survives a collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition names the whole for a part: this is the rounded end section of a church.
explanation.definitionFit: A vaulted semicircular recess at the east end of a church building.

clue.text: Approaching hospital visitors sign

definitions.meaning: in the direction of, coming nearer
a hospital notice pointing guests along to the patient rooms

explanation.surface: A guest nears the signpost in a hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: Heading closer to; also a signpost reading 'to wards' for visitors.
